capabilities: Insert ready-made counter and track blocks from the command palette or right-click menu
Change counter values with minus/plus buttons or by typing values, written back as plain text
Run resets for rests, sessions or days, with undo of the last change
Lay out lists and text in two or three columns with a callout
Generate compatible sheets with AI assistants using the bundled llms.txt reference
extras: Not yet published to Community plugins ('once published'); installable via BRAT or manually from releases. Includes an example D&D 5e sheet and an llms.txt file for AI-assisted sheet generation.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to make character-sheet values interactive, so updating HP, spell slots or tracks means editing numbers by hand.
summary: Turns YAML blocks in notes into clickable counters, checkbox tracks and column layouts for tabletop RPG character sheets, saved as plain text.
